title: Milestones, and a deadline you set for yourself

videos.script: A project with no end date does not end. It becomes the thing you are always about to finish. {{end}} A portfolio project has no client and no manager, so nobody will set the date for you. You set it yourself, and then you make it hold. {{you}} The tool for that is the milestone: a state of the project you could show somebody, with a date on it. Not a percentage, not a feeling that it is nearly there. A thing that runs, on a day. {{milestone}} loanbook had four milestones, each tagged in git. It also had a deadline, and a plan for the day one was missed. That day comes.
